necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10) alongside nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current management strategies. This service addresses the clinical need defined by diagnosis codes I25.10, I34.0, and R00.2.
